text: Hello, boys and girls.I'm Miss Wong.Nice to see you again.同学们,大家好。我是来自洪口区第四中心小学的王老师。小小的J,大小的J,小小的J,你能写,你能读,听,然后跟随我。I, insect.Good.J, jar.Nice.Look, Harry has a jar.Listen and follow.Harry has a jar.Try again.And he has an insect too.Harry has an insect.Where is it?An insect in a jar.You can read.Here is a rhyme about Harry, his jar and the insect.Let's read together, shall we?You can read well.Look, the children are talking about friends.Alice has two friends.One is Peter, one is Alice.Alice的另外一位好朋友是谁呢?Watch the video and find out.She's a girl.She is, yes, she's Kitty.Look at Kitty.Is she short?Is she fat?Now we know Kitty, Alice and Peter are friends.上一节课的故事里, Kitty comes to Peter's home.Peter shows Kitty some photos.Let's read their dialogue.And you are Kitty.You go first please.Yes, she is.She's my sister.This time you are Peter.Have a try.Who's he?He's my brother.Is he your brother?He's small.今天的故事里, Kitty会去哪一位朋友家做课呢?Good guess.Kitty comes to Alice's home.Alice shows Kitty some family photos.Who are they?Look.This is my father.He's tall.My father is tall.He can ride a bike with me.He can hold me up.I like my father.Who's in the next photo?This is my mother.She's young.Alice, the mama,看起来很年轻.Kitty says,She's young.Is she tall?Kitty asks,Is she tall?Read after me.注意你的语调.Look at the photo.She is tall.Could you be Alice?Tell Kitty.Now this time, you are Kitty.Can you try to ask?Alice says,My mother is young.She's tall.She can cook nice food.Mmm, yummy.I give my mother a hug every day.How are you today, mom?I like my mother.Can you try to read?Who's the next family member, Alice?This is my grandmother.She's old.Look at my grandmother.花白的头发,额头的皱儿She's old.Kitty says,She's old.Kitty asks,You are Kitty.Can you try to ask Alice?你是这样问的吗?Good try.Let's ask Alice together.Look at the photo, children.Can you try to say?No, she isn't.She isn't fat.You are Alice.Could you tell Kitty?Alice says,My grandmother isn't fat.But she can read a lot.We always read together.And I help my grandmother too.I like my grandmother.My father, my mother, my grandmother.Guess, children.Does Alice have sisters or brothers?This is my brother, Tom.She has a brother, Tom.Tom,又有哪些外型特征呢?你能帮助Kitty问一问Alice吗?Is Tom short?Is he.Have a try please.Is he short?Yes, he is.Tom is short.Is he fat?No, he isn't.Tom isn't fat.He is short.Look, this is my brother, Tom.Alice says,I talk with my brother every day.And we play together all the time.I like my brother.Today Alice shows Kitty some family photos.Can you say with Alice?He is tall.She is young.She is old.This is my brother.My father, mother, grandmother, brother and me.That's my family.I love my family.Alice loves her family.Let's enjoy a rhyme about lovely family.She is my mummy.She is kind and dear.He is my daddy.Big and tall.She is my sister.Thin and nice.He is my brother.Sweet and small.Kind and dear.And small.She says, I love my family.And I think we all love our family.Let's say it together.So much for today's class.Thanks for watching.Goodbye boys and girls.
